Eligible: stock and goods in transit; consigned goods are their own class; goods not yet delivered and work in fabrication are not eligible. Maximum loss: a 30% fall on the part not offset, plus 2% of the whole for the goods not tracking PAXG (grade, location, the lender's reference price). Eligible value after the maximum loss = the eligible class less the whole maximum loss. The offset is the short read back from the venue account, split across deals by what each holds; anyone can read that account's fills from the venue's public API. Funding on the offset since the deal was bought is the venue's own record for the account, this deal's share by grams; positive means the market paid for holding the offset.
